videos.description: Krabs and Plankton woo customers with greasy entrees. Then in 'Model Sponge', SpongeBob tries a career at being a model in a kitchen sponge commercial.

videos.title: The Patrick Star Show
videos.description: The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante in 'Neighborhood Wash', then in 'A Fridge Too Far', Patrick, GrandPat, and Cecil want Bunny to honor their accomplishments on the fridge.

videos.title: The Patrick Star Show
videos.description: A tiny futuristic city exacts revenge on Patrick in 'The Wrath of Shmandor', and then in 'There Goes The Neighbourhood', Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbours.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Pearl has a facial blemish right before the big school dance in 'Barnacle Face', and in 'Pet Sitter Pat', SpongeBob asks Patrick to look after Gary while he's away at Grandma's birthday party.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: The Sharks are the toughest guys in town, but their next confrontation might be too much in 'Sharks vs. Pods', and then in 'CopyBob DittoPants', Plankton clones SpongeBob to steal the secret formula.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: An accident causes Patrick and Karen to switch bodies in 'Switch Glitch', then in 'Prickly Pests', a mischievous camp prank goes terribly wrong.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: It's stand-up comedy night at Kamp Koral, and the campers are ready to laugh until they scream in 'Wise Kraken', then in 'Squatch Swap', Patrick gets confused while out in the woods.

videos.title: The Patrick Star Show
videos.description: The fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video in 'Safety Worst', then in 'De-Pat-ment Store', Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall.

videos.title: The Patrick Star Show
videos.description: Cecil shows Patrick his moustache collection in 'Dad's Stache Stash', and then in 'A Root Galoot', The Star family brings a mandrake root into their home.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: SpongeBob and Patrick use carrier clams to send messages to each other in 'SquidBird', and in 'Allergy Attack!', after his kazillionth Krabby Patty, SpongeBob thinks he's developed an allergy to them.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Puff's new substitute gives SpongeBob a crash course in driving in 'Potato Puff', then in 'There Will Be Grease!', Mr. Krabs and Plankton must work together after discovering a well of grease.

videos.title: The Patrick Star Show
videos.description: Cecil's boss visits the house in 'Sitcom Stars', then in 'The Show Must Go Yawn', Squidina is bedridden, and Patrick has to run his show without her.

videos.title: The Patrick Star Show
videos.description: Tinkle, Ouchie, and Pinkeye must venture back home together in 'The Uncredible Journey', then in 'Host-a-Palooza', Patrick gets injured, so his family members take turns hosting the show.

videos.title: The Patrick Star Show
videos.description: In an episode about boats, Cecil teaches Patrick how to drive in 'Driven to Drive', then in 'A Patty in Time', Patrick time-travels in a race for the Krusty Krab's newest menu item.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: The Krusty Krab crew goes to a big concert to sell krabby patties in 'Krusty Koncessionaires', then in 'Dream Hoppers', SpongeBob explores the melodious dreamscapes of his sleeping neighbours.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: The long-lost episode of Mermaid Man is finally showing in 'Appointment TV', and then in 'Karen's Virus', Karen gets a computer virus, and it's up to SpongeBob to get it out of her.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Pearl gets a job to be cool like her friends in 'Mall Girl Pearl', and then in 'Two Thumbs Down', SpongeBob loses the use of his thumbs and must get them working before his entire life falls apart.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Gary is hoping to enjoy some tasty snail snacks that SpongeBob has brought home in 'Treats!', and then in 'For Here Or To Go?', Plankton wins a free Krabby Patty, but Mr Krabs won't hand it over.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: SpongeBob is injured at work in 'The Splinter', while in 'Slide Whistle Stooges', SpongeBob and Patrick are driving Squidward crazy with their new slide whistles.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: SpongeBob has trouble saying goodbye to the most perfect Krabby Patty he has ever cooked up in 'To Love A Patty', and then in 'Breath of Fresh Squidward', Squidward becomes the most jovial Squid ever.
